description: baseline

Implement high-confidence Triton structural fast paths only for cheaply provable cases such as exact upper-triangular, diagonal, or zero-column matrices detected by GPU reductions; emit LAPACK-compatible compact Householder output with tau=0 where valid and fall back to torch.geqrf for anything not exactly certified.
Triton-certified trailing-zero and upper fast paths failed validation: embedded reduced geqrf produced NaN Q for rank-deficient n=512/1024 cases.
Triton reduction certifies exact upper-triangular inputs and returns H=A,tau=0; falls back to torch.geqrf otherwise, but scan overhead slowed geomean.
Restricted Triton upper certification to batch=1,n=4096 to avoid scanning every dense case; validates but active benchmark lacks upper input so score is baseline-equivalent/slightly slower.
Added Triton tail-zero certification for n=512/1024 rank-deficient inputs; factors only the leading 3n/4 columns and zero-embeds H,tau, improving rankdef shape and geomean.
Limited Triton tail-zero fast path to n=512 after n=1024 scan had no active exact-zero win; validates but measured slightly slower than prior best within noise.

Best score 113377.478236 at e822fc3057972cd53260694a8f9c51a084720f6d: Triton tail-zero certification for exact n=512 rankdef inputs plus zero-embedded compact Householder output improved the rankdef benchmark (~950ms to ~755ms) and geomean vs baseline 115508.049. Full lower-triangle certification for all shapes validated but was slower due to scan overhead; restricting to upper-only active shape was neutral. A reduced n=512-only variant was comparable but slightly slower than the n=512/1024 tail-zero version, likely noise; next briefs could fuse zero embedding into Triton to avoid torch.zeros/slice fills or build per-matrix mixed-batch routing.

Off the e822fc30 global-best tail-zero fast path, micro-optimize the existing n=512/1024 certified whole-batch case by fusing zero-fill and H,tau embedding into Triton scatter kernels while preserving exact current semantics; only after a measured win, try minimal stable batch-index compaction/scatter for mixed batches without changing the QR math or certification predicate.
Fused Triton H/tau embedding used a single contiguous H offset even though the panel view from data[:,:,:r] has original n stride, causing invalid rankdef Householder output.
Adjusted fused Triton H embedding to read panel with original n stride, but rankdef validation still produced NaN Q; abandoning this invalid fused-H variant before continuing.

Fused zero-fill plus H/tau embedding into stride-aware Triton scatter kernels; validates, rankdef shape marginally faster, but geomean 113311.295 stayed within noise of parent rerun and above best parent.
Kept Torch H zero/copy but fused tau zero-fill/scatter in Triton; validates but measured slower than full fused and parent, so tau launch overhead does not pay.

Brief exhausted. Best edited score was 113311.295308 at 72ff75604431081837ebf257079921b902e1b249: stride-aware Triton fused H/tau zero-fill embedding validated and slightly improved the official parent metric, but a parent rerun measured 113306.275905, so the apparent gain is noise-level. Tau-only fusion was slower at 113387.453299; initial fused attempts failed until panel stride handling was fixed. Profile for the best fused attempt was saved; next work should avoid extra Triton launches or pursue actual mixed-batch compaction only if certification can be made per-matrix cheaply.

Micro-specialize 47d4 exact tail-zero routing: profile overhead, split n=512 and n=1024 fast paths with a cheap whole-batch tail predicate that bypasses per-matrix compaction only when globally conclusive, otherwise fall back exactly to 47d4 routing; tune Triton certification block sizes per n and measurement-gate any n=1024 routing bypass on active mixed/nearrank correctness and metric.
Split n=512 routing with a cheap whole-batch Triton tail predicate before per-matrix mask/compaction, and used 2048 blocks for n=512 scans; validation passed and metric improved to 113176.939.
Tuned n=512 Triton global/mask tail-certification scans to 4096 elements per program; validation passed and metric improved to 113101.086.

Measurement-gated n=1024 global tail predicate in addition to n=512; validation passed including mixed/nearrank, but metric regressed to 113112.847 versus n512-only 113101.086, so this should not be kept.

Brief exhausted. Best score 113101.086327 at f414e1bc2146983ce90a32032aee2c5309655e18: split n=512 routing with a cheap whole-batch Triton tail predicate and tuned n=512 certification block size to 4096, preserving 47d4 per-matrix fallback exactly. Adding the same global predicate for n=1024 validated but regressed to 113112.847136, so branch was reset to n512-only best. Final profile saved for f414e1bc; profiling under nsys perturbed runtime to 114503.876 but benchmark row is the scoring measurement.

From f414e1bc, micro-sweep only n=512 tail-certification Triton scan block sizes: test global whole-batch and per-matrix mask block sizes independently in {2048,4096,8192,16384}, preserving f414 exact routing semantics and n=1024 behavior unchanged; validate every variant and commit only measured wins over f414.
Swept n=512 global whole-batch tail predicate block size to 8192 while mask stayed 4096; validation passed but metric regressed to 113151.305, so not a measured win over f414.
Swept n=512 per-matrix mask tail-certification block size to 8192 while global stayed 4096; validation passed but metric regressed to 113131.419, so not a measured win over f414.
Swept n=512 per-matrix mask tail-certification block size to 2048 while global stayed 4096; validation passed and metric improved to 113036.871 over f414.
Swept n=512 global whole-batch and per-matrix mask block sizes to 2048; validation passed but metric regressed to 113110.587 versus mask-only 2048 at 113036.871.

Brief exhausted. Best measured win is fd7c2ba7c0ab1fcc73c06bef62b8942215ac902a with metric 113036.870704: n=512 global whole-batch scan block remains 4096, per-matrix mask scan block changes to 2048, preserving f414 routing and n=1024 behavior. Other swept variants validated but regressed: global 8192/mask4096 = 113151.305426, global4096/mask8192 = 113131.418746, global2048/mask2048 = 113110.587243. Final profile saved for fd7c2ba7; nsys profiling perturbed geomean to 114473.445, so use logged benchmark row for scoring.

Off 3f3, add a narrow certified upper-triangular fast path for n=512/1024 only: use a cheap Triton blockwise lower-triangle zero check while preserving 3f3 tail-zero/all-certified routing, emit compact output with tau=0 only after validating the convention on diagonal, negative-diagonal, zero-diagonal, and rank-deficient upper cases, and fall back unchanged otherwise.

Added certified n=512/1024 upper-triangular tau=0 fast path before tail routing; convention probes for diagonal/negative/zero/rankdef upper passed and validation passed, but active metric regressed to 113162.324 due to lower-triangle scan overhead.

Moved n=512/1024 certified upper tau=0 fast path after tail precheck and gated it to small batches, preserving 3f3 tail routing for large active n=512 batches; validation passed and metric improved slightly to 112975.677.

Brief exhausted. Verified tau=0 compact output for n=512/1024 positive diagonal, negative diagonal, zero diagonal upper, rank-deficient upper, and dense upper cases. Final profile saved for cda2ba2b; nsys perturbed runtime to 114592.054.

Combined 0024 n=32 Triton QR path with cda2 post-tail-precheck batch<=4 n=512/1024 upper-triangular tau=0 shortcut; build and validation passed, fallback routing preserved, metric 101673.088 roughly matches 0024 within noise.

Derived torch.geqrf compact Householder convention with a wrapped probe and implemented direct one-program fixed-size Triton n=176 QR preserving f07 n=32 and 3f3 routing; build passed but validation failed n=176 factor residual, so direct candidate is not acceptable.

Added official-residual guard around the n=176 Triton QR candidate so invalid compact Householder output falls back to torch.geqrf; validation and guards passed, but benchmark regressed to 106210.944 due to candidate/guard overhead, so it does not beat fallback.

Restored n=176 to torch.geqrf fallback after the guarded Triton prototype validated but regressed; build/validation passed and benchmark recovered to 101689.737, so per brief the accepted state leaves fallback untouched while preserving f07 n=32 and 3f3 routing.

Brief exhausted. Derived and probed torch.geqrf compact Householder/tau convention for n=176 successfully. Direct fixed-size Triton n=176 QR built but failed validation with large factor residual. A guarded residual-checked fallback variant validated but benchmarked at 106210.943665, much slower than fallback. Final accepted commit c9cb22b2 leaves n=176 fallback untouched while preserving f07 n=32 Triton and 3f3 routing; benchmark 101689.736994, profile saved; nsys profile run measured 103179.654886 under profiler overhead.

Parent f07b1aaf: add an exact n=32 pre-QR fast path for already upper-triangular, diagonal, or zero-tail matrices. Detect cheaply inside the Triton route before launching full QR, preserve exact compact QR/tau output semantics, and benchmark only if generic n32 overhead is near-zero; prefer a small fused predicate+copy kernel over Python-side branching.

Added a fused in-kernel n=32 lower-triangle predicate during the existing copy stage; upper/diagonal matrices return copied H with tau=0 before full QR, while dense generic n=32 stays in the f07 QR path. Build and validation passed; benchmark 101658.164 with n32 shape 79.838us, near-zero generic overhead but no clear geomean win versus f07.

Moved the n=32 upper predicate to a second lower-triangle-only scan after copy; validation passed, but benchmark regressed to 101796.818 and n32 rose to 81.183us, so this overhead is worse than the fused-copy predicate.

Restored the better fused-copy n=32 upper/diagonal fast-path predicate after the separate lower scan regressed. This final variant preserves f07 dense QR semantics, returns copied upper H with tau=0 for exact upper/diagonal n32 inputs, validation already passed, and best benchmark for this brief is 101658.164.

Brief exhausted. Changed the 2-lane n=32 Triton QR trailing-column loop to process pairs of j columns per loop while preserving reflector order. Validation passed, but benchmark regressed badly to 103050.693 and n32 rose to 94.256us, so simple B=2 unrolling is not viable.

Increased the n=32 2-lane QR trailing update tile to 32x4 columns. Validation passed, n32 dropped to 42.200us, and geomean improved to 96410.733, well past the 100287.945 target.
Increased the n=32 2-lane QR trailing update tile to 32x8 columns. Validation and guards passed, n32 measured 41.069us, and geomean improved to 96277.190, the best tile size tested.
